ideas.title: I swallow what I hit
ideas.nearest: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: It builds on round 2's Fling me, so the fling gesture is already expected. Things the player knows drifting and turning inside a refractive, tinted body, lit through it, is something only a path tracer shows, and here the material is the joke rather than decoration. It only works if the objects really sit inside a volume that wobbles with the body. If the jelly is a tinted shell with props parented to its centre, the swallow is a hiding trick and the hiccup arc is a keyframe.

ideas.title: Fling me harder and there are more of me
ideas.critique: A body that splits into two on impact and slurps back together when the halves meet is a way of moving that nothing on the island has had, and halves wandering off to find each other is a real character beat. The weak spots are a half face on each blob and singing in thirds, which turn it into a gimmick. And if the split is one mesh swapped for two smaller copies instead of a body that tears and merges, it is a pop, not jelly.
